definitions.explanation: Work done sitting at a desk, such as paperwork or computer work, as opposed to physical work or work out in the field.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一日中|いちにちじゅう}→一日中：09519_ichinichijuu⟧デスクワークだ。
examples.english: I do desk work all day.
Desk work gives me stiff shoulders.

examples.japanese: ⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{異動|いどう}→異動：01818_idou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧デスクワーク⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{中心|ちゅうしん}→中心：01467_chuushin⟧になった。
examples.english: Since I moved over from sales, my work is now mostly desk work.

notes:
Often mentioned together with its physical effects: stiff shoulders, back pain, lack of exercise.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- デスクワーク⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧: to do a lot of desk work
- デスクワーク⟦{中心|ちゅうしん}→中心：01467_chuushin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧: a mainly desk-based job
- ⟦{長時間|ちょうじかん}→長時間：10165_choujikan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧デスクワーク: long hours at a desk

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{事務|じむ}→事務：11418_jimu⟧: office work, clerical work — names the kind of job rather than the posture
- ⟦{肉体労働|にくたいろうどう}→肉体労働：22825_nikutairoudou⟧: physical labor — the opposite
